title: Baltimore Pike Brick Farmhouse (c.1890)
description: A handsome 1890s brick farmhouse with original hardwood floors, a wraparound porch, and a restored bank barn. Eight-plus acres of gently rolling pasture bordered by mature hedgerow, minutes from downtown Gettysburg.

title: Marsh Creek Land Parcel
address: 62 Marsh Creek Rd, Mill Creek, PA 00000
description: Thirty-eight acres of mostly tillable ground along Marsh Creek, currently leased for row crops. Road frontage, public water available at the road, and a soil map on file showing strong Class II farmland.

title: Wheatland Farmhouse & Outbuildings
description: A well-kept 1970s farmhouse updated top to bottom, with a 40x60 pole barn, fenced pasture, and a spring-fed pond. Long been run as a small cattle operation; equally suited to a hobby farm or horse property.

title: Seminary Ridge Cottage
description: A move-in-ready cottage a short walk from Seminary Ridge, with an updated kitchen, screened porch, and a level, fenced back yard. Ideal starter home or in-town pied-a-terre.

title: Rock Creek Grazing Land
address: 215 Rock Creek Church Rd, Mill Creek, PA 00000
description: Forty-five acres of fenced pasture along Rock Creek with a run-in shed and gravity-fed water. Long history as grazing ground for a beef cattle herd; also suitable for hay or a future homesite.

title: Oak Ridge Orchard Farm
description: A sixty-acre producing apple and peach orchard with a renovated farmhouse, cold storage building, and roadside stand. A rare turn-key opportunity to continue an established Adams County orchard operation.

title: The Herr Homestead (c.1852)
address: 310 Herr's Ridge Rd, Oak Hollow, PA 00000
description: A stone-and-frame homestead dating to 1852, lovingly maintained through six generations. Original summer kitchen, restored bank barn, twenty-two acres, and documented Civil War-era provenance.

title: Table Rock View Lot
address: 0 Table Rock Rd, Oak Hollow, PA 00000
description: A wooded 5.5-acre building lot with long-range views toward South Mountain. Perc-approved for a conventional septic system; electric at the road. A quiet, buildable spot minutes from Gettysburg.
